**Make It Your Own!**


Customization options are endless! Pair the paper pattern with your favorite leather, hardware, carving pattern, or finishes of your choice!


**Painted In Blue**


Born and raised in the vibrant creative landscape of New York, Tony "Josiesboy" Gonzalez has established himself as an accomplished visual artist and designer. He is particularly recognized for his signature style, characterized by bold linework and the impactful use of vivid colors that bring his creations to life. Tony’s artistic footprint can be seen on striking murals and diverse projects throughout New York and in other states. His talent has led to collaborations with prominent brands such as Red Bull, Urban Outfitters, and Kidrobot, among others. Driven by a passion for craftsmanship and design, Anthony has expanded his artistic endeavors with the inception of Painted in Blue, a creative house specializing in meticulously crafted leather goods that embody his unique aesthetic.
